blocks.text: connect validates the value-store contract. New record keys are [`__storage_web_entity_v2__`,entityName,encodeFlatStorageKey(id)]. Reads also accept historical [entityName,id] keys; explicit migrate moves them. Value-only backends use entityName:encodedId. An envelope `__v` newer than the definition fails VERSION_UNSUPPORTED rather than being overwritten by older code.

get(id,ctx?) returns undefined when absent and materializes through decode/migration/validation. Read-time migration does not persist. put extracts the domain key, refuses null/undefined, prepares the entire value, and returns IStorageKey. Record backends atomically write the new position and delete the historical one. remove clears both positions.

list/stream options include range, limit, orderBy, direction, and onInvalid, plus discriminated indexed options. Ranges address logical ids. Limit defaults to undefined and must be a non-negative safe integer. Direction is next/prev. orderBy defaults to defaultOrderBy, otherwise scan order. Sorting buffers all matching records before applying limit rather than retaining a constant-memory stream; non-number/NaN comparison results fail EXTENSION_FAILED at comparator/entity.orderBy.

onInvalid defaults to skip; alternatives are throw or a callback returning skip/throw. Issues contain key/raw/optional record/stage/cause with decode/migrate/validate stages. Other callback return values fail INVALID_CONFIG; ordinary callback failure becomes VALIDATION_FAILED while storage-family errors retain identity. Value-only stores scan all keys, filter entityName prefixes, and diagnose once. Record stores scan the new prefix then the whole store for historical keys, deduplicating by seenIds. list buffers the stream.

migrate defaults batchSize to 100, a positive safe integer, and uses the same onInvalid policy. Results count scanned/eligible/migrated/skipped/alreadyCurrent/conflicted. A conflicting record batch retries individually once, rechecking newer versions; remaining conflicts are counted rather than retried indefinitely. IndexedDB checkpoints repository:name:migration with phase/status/counts/lastPhysicalKey and a fingerprint of entity/version/key/schema/codec/migration versions; mismatch restarts scanning. Memory/value-only backends have no checkpoint channel.

batch(run,ctx?) requires a genuine record transaction; value-only stores reject UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY rather than simulate atomicity. Its scope get/put/remove handles envelopes/keys and commits the final draft. Failure does not commit the draft, and the application chooses any retry budget.

Indexes belong to entity definitions, not backend schema. A single path supports unique/multiEntry/revision, defaulting to false/false/1. Compound paths prohibit multiEntry:true. Selectors require select and explicit revision; bump revision after changing a persistent projection. multiEntry projects array members, while selectors return the declared single/multiple-key shape.

findBy returns the first result or undefined; findManyBy returns an array; streamBy iterates asynchronously. Indexed options do not duplicate the ordinary range field. IndexedDB maintains a fixed sidecar projection table atomically with record writes/removals/migration. A changed epoch between pages fails INDEX_QUERY_INVALIDATED, requiring a fresh query; an index row without its record is INDEX_ORPHAN.

Other backends reuse the same projection/comparison/uniqueness rules without claiming native indexes. Record put/batch/migrate validate the final draft, allowing same-id replacement, deleted-key reuse, and writing a new owner before deleting the old one. INDEX_UNIQUE_CONFLICT leaves no partial commit. Unique commits update the two-part marker [`__storage_web_entity_v2__`,entityName] to detect concurrent new owners through the existing revision mechanism. Raw record iteration can see this marker; entity queries/migrations do not mistake it for a three-part business record.

Value-only writes prepare schema/codec and snapshot raw text outside the lock, then recheck under host Web Locks. Racing preparation yields TRANSACTION_CONFLICT; an existing owner in a stable snapshot yields INDEX_UNIQUE_CONFLICT. Fallback checks scan and project without persistent sidecars. Ordinary selector failures retain EXTENSION_FAILED/cause; native backfill retains the original exception.

Cross-page coordination requires host Web Locks; injected ports without them serialize only within one module instance. Server-side cookie changes are outside this constraint. If backfill and saving its failed state both fail, native AggregateError carries INDEX_BACKFILL_FAILED with the primary cause and all original errors. Expired owner/generation/checkpoints use INDEX_BACKFILL_STALE. Existing ensure/iteration deadlines are reused rather than adding another wait owner.

createStorageHost(options?) is always asynchronous with no plugins by default. It returns after the first plugin tuple installs atomically; later calls use host.use. StorageHostFacade is the same empty shell with explicit subsequent use, not a second runtime.

Options reuse backend config plus optional id. Literal tuples infer exact backend types and reject duplicate ids at compile time. Runtime admission still validates actual handles/providers/stores and Feature topology. Publication follows successful create/prepare/install for the whole batch, with rollback on failure instead of partial registry state. Platform access happens when the selected plugin installs.

Host installTimeoutMs defaults to 30000 for the entire batch and requires a finite non-negative number, not false; scheduler defaults to systemScheduler. report defaults to undefined, leaving the existing diagnostic path without a caller-provided sink; callbacks receive late rejection/cleanup without replacing the primary failure. Concurrent installation fails STORAGE_HOST_BUSY. backend(id) looks up an exact id, hasBackend returns boolean, and backends gives a detached ordinary Map typed ReadonlyMap. Editing that copy changes no registry; there is no implicit default id.

Dispose seals admission, clears registries, cancels installation, waits for admitted mutations/queries, and releases adapters/stores/transports through PluginHost/lifecycle. Repeated calls share the same Promise. Cleanup failure leaves a terminal Host with STORAGE_HOST_DISPOSE_FAILED and reachable causes/errors; backend/use/liveQuery cannot revive it. Borrowed reactive Runtimes are not destroyed. Internal registration/service names and WeakMap admission metadata are not application API; use backend/reactiveBackend and plugin.id.

The five plugins/reactive/* factories are memoryReactive/localStorageReactive/sessionStorageReactive/cookiesReactive/indexedDbReactive. Each creates a backend with its one adapter. Ordinary backend plugins do not add Host.liveQuery. reactiveBackend(id) returns its admitted handle, or undefined when that adapter is not installed; it never falls back to another id. A closed Host still rejects access.

liveQuery requires backendId, the caller's runtime, and query({store,signal}). scope/matches default to undefined. Only two known unequal scopes exclude a change; absent matches treats it as related, and predicate failure reports then refreshes conservatively. keepPreviousData defaults to true, retaining old data while refreshing. equals defaults to undefined and admits each new value without an implicit Object.is policy; a provided comparator can suppress equal visible replacements, with callback failures reported.

Signal defaults to undefined and cancels the whole query. timeoutMs defaults to undefined and applies per generation. report defaults to undefined; a supplied reporter’s failures are contained without changing query results. State is a readonly computed in the same reactive Runtime with loading/ready/refreshing/error/disposed states. ready projects settlement of the initial work and retains identity across refresh; if fetching is still active when an older Promise settles, it follows the currently active Promise. refresh joins that Promise while fetching and otherwise requests a refetch. Resource generations prevent stale results overwriting new ones. Dispose seals refresh admission, cancels the generation, releases subscriptions, and awaits admitted work with one repeated completion Promise.

consistency freezes the actual adapter mode/visibility/optional poll interval: memory has instance-local push; local/session use browser events or polling with document/top-level-context restrictions; Cookie sees only JS-visible entries; IndexedDB combines after-commit changes and eventual same-origin coordination. None claims arbitrary raw-writer capture or cross-device replication.

defineReactiveAdapterFeature creates a kind-hidden native Feature. PluginHost injects the exact store and Host-snapshotted scheduler rather than accepting a caller-invented backend-kind token. Normal subscribe must synchronously return a disposer. PromiseLike in its signature allows observing invalid results: asynchronous subscription fails REACTIVE_FEATURE_INVALID and aborts/closes the original scope, releasing a disposer immediately if it arrives late.

invalidate() without a change refreshes all queries on that adapter, bypassing scope/matches that need known change metadata. It invents no sequence/origin; a supplied change follows ordinary filtering. Resource owns generations/refresh/cancellation, lifecycle owns resource release, and event-subscriber owns fanout. Query/adapter/backend cleanup remains terminal with original errors reachable.

StorageError(code,details?,message?) requires code with optional details. Source is @migaia/storage-web; top-level message defaults to `[storage-web] ${code}` and may be overridden by the third argument. Details may include backend/key/existingChannel/attemptedChannel/extensionStage/operation/cause. Cause can be undefined; when supplied it retains the original object, message, and stack rather than making the top-level message equal to it. The error is shallow-frozen, without freezing its cause. Adding operation/stage metadata to an existing StorageError preserves its message and keeps the complete old error as cause.

STORAGE_WEB_SOURCE, StorageErrorCode, and StorageErrorText are stable exports. Branch on source/code; text primarily supports extension implementations. Import contract INVALID_ARGUMENT/INVALID_KEY/UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY/STORE_DISPOSED/ABORTED from storage-contract. Existing storage-family failures keep identity across schema/codec/namespace boundaries.

rows: Missing/refused backend, quota, or oversized complete Cookie assignment
Encoding, cloning, decoding, or envelope failure
Transaction/exclusive commit failure or changed revision/epoch/snapshot
Persistent schema/entity envelope newer than the code
Invisible Cookie write or ambiguous scope
Missing indexed record, occupied unique value, or invalidated page
Backfill plus failure-state error, or expired owner/generation/checkpoint
Invalid plugin/store or failed install batch
Query/invalidation failure or terminal cleanup failure

blocks.text: For unavailable backends, explicitly prompt or choose memory. Check Cookie scope/policy after WRITE_FAILED. Distinguish channel conflicts, occupied unique values, and optimistic races before retrying. Newer formats need compatible code, not a deleted migration graph. Structured data on text-only stores needs an explicit codec/backend choice. Judge cross-page query refresh by consistency rather than treating it as replication. Closed Hosts/queries/backends require new instances.

STORAGE_WEB_SOURCE、StorageErrorCode、StorageErrorText 为稳定公开常量；业务分支比较 source/code，文本主要供扩展实现复用。storage-contract 的 INVALID_ARGUMENT/INVALID_KEY/UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY/STORE_DISPOSED/ABORTED 从其独立入口导入；跨 schema/codec/namespace 传播已有 storage 家族错误时保留原码与原因，不二次覆盖。

投影无原记录、唯一键占用、分页失效
回填与失败状态都失败，或 owner/代次/检查点失效
ID 非法、重复或未安装
plugin/store 契约非法，或 batch 安装失败

缺服务或所选 backend adapter

operation: Name of the operation, when known.
stage: Repository stage of an invalid record.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content: Recover from quota, conflict or unavailable backends by `code`.

symbols.identity: packages/storage-web/dist/types/errors.d.ts:StorageError:export declare class StorageError extends Error { /** Canonical storage-web diagnostic source. */ readonly source: string; /** Semantic failure scenario; branch on this rather than message text. */ readonly code: IStorageErrorCode; /** Backend associated with this operation. */ readonly backend?: IBackendKind; /** Logical key associated with this operation. */ readonly key?: string | IStorageKey; /** Channel already occupying the conflicting key. */ readonly existingChannel?: IStorageChannel; /** Channel the rejected write attempted to use. */ readonly attemptedChannel?: IStorageChannel; /** Extension phase responsible for this failure. */ readonly extensionStage?: IExtensionStage; /** Operation name attached by its owning boundary. */ readonly operation?: string; /** Internal repository stage used to apply invalid-record policy. */ readonly stage?: 'decode' | 'migrate' | 'validate'; /** Capture diagnostic details once and freeze this error without replacing its original cause. */ constructor(code: IStorageErrorCode, details?: IStorageErrorDetails, message?: string, stage?: 'decode' | 'migrate' | 'validate'); }

blocks.text: StorageError(code,details?,message?) 的 code 必填，details 可省略；source 固定 @migaia/storage-web，顶层 message 默认 `[storage-web] ${code}`，可用第三参数覆盖。details 可含 backend/key/existingChannel/attemptedChannel/extensionStage/operation/cause；cause 可以 undefined，存在时保留原始对象与其 message/stack，不承诺顶层 message 等于底层异常。实例浅冻结，不深冻结 cause。已有 StorageError 补充 operation/stage 元数据时，新边界保留原 message，并把完整旧错误放 cause。

STORAGE_WEB_SOURCE、StorageErrorCode、StorageErrorText 为稳定公开常量；业务分支比较 source/code，文本主要供扩展实现复用。storage-contract 的 INVALID_ARGUMENT/INVALID_KEY/UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY/STORE_DISPOSED/ABORTED 从其独立入口导入；跨 schema/codec/namespace 传播已有 storage 家族错误时保留原码与原因，不二次覆盖。

rows: 后端缺失/拒写、配额、完整 Cookie assignment 过大
编码/解码、结构化复制或 envelope 失败
事务/独占提交失败，或 revision/epoch/快照变化
持久化 schema 或 entity envelope 高于当前代码
扩展回调未归类失败，查看 extensionStage/cause
Cookie 回读不可见或同名 scope 歧义
投影无原记录、唯一键占用、分页失效
回填与失败状态都失败，或 owner/代次/检查点失效
ID 非法、重复或未安装
plugin/store 契约非法，或 batch 安装失败
Host 正忙、终态或清理失败
reactive 定义或依赖图非法
缺服务或所选 backend adapter
查询/失效失败或终态清理失败

blocks.text: 遇到不可用后端，显式提示或选择 memory；Cookie 写失败检查 scope/策略；冲突先区分跨通道重复、unique 占用与乐观竞争；未知版本升级代码，不删图跳迁移；structured 数据落 text-only 时显式换 codec 或后端；live query 跨页刷新按 consistency 判断，不把提示当全量复制。Host/Query/backend 关闭后新建，不尝试复活。

symbols.purpose: Table of this package’s 37 stable error codes; values are the strings on error.code. `INDEX_BACKFILL_FAILED` identifies backfill and failed-readiness persistence failing together on a native AggregateError.
symbols.core:
unavailable: `BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE`: storage is disabled or missing (private mode); pick `memoryStorageHost` or ask for access.
quotaExceeded: `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`: the browser quota is full; delete data or use IndexedDB.
valueTooLarge: `VALUE_TOO_LARGE`: a cookie value is over 4 KB.
serializeFailed: `SERIALIZE_FAILED`: encoding the value failed.
deserializeFailed: `DESERIALIZE_FAILED`: decoding the stored value failed.
validationFailed: `VALIDATION_FAILED`: the schema rejected the value.
migrationFailed: `MIGRATION_FAILED`: a migration function threw.
transactionFailed: `TRANSACTION_FAILED`: the IndexedDB transaction failed or the callback threw.
duplicateKey: `DUPLICATE_KEY`: the key is used by another channel; pass `conflictPolicy: "replace"` to overwrite.
versionUnsupported: `VERSION_UNSUPPORTED`: stored data is newer than this code.
extensionFailed: `EXTENSION_FAILED`: a schema, codec or comparator threw.
transactionConflict: `TRANSACTION_CONFLICT`: data changed concurrently; re-read and retry.
writeFailed: `WRITE_FAILED`: a written cookie was not visible afterwards.
cookieScopeAmbiguous: `COOKIE_SCOPE_AMBIGUOUS`: one cookie name is visible in several scopes.
invalidConfig: `INVALID_CONFIG`: an option or scope is invalid.
indexOrphan: `INDEX_ORPHAN`: an index points to a missing record; rebuild it.
indexUniqueConflict: `INDEX_UNIQUE_CONFLICT`: a unique index key belongs to another record.
indexQueryInvalidated: `INDEX_QUERY_INVALIDATED`: data changed during paging; restart the query.
liveQueryDisposed: `LIVE_QUERY_DISPOSED`: the live query was disposed; create a new one.
indexBackfillStale: `INDEX_BACKFILL_STALE`: an index backfill checkpoint expired; reconnect and retry.
indexBackfillFailed: `INDEX_BACKFILL_FAILED`: backfill and persisting failed readiness both failed. The native AggregateError keeps the primary error first in errors and as cause, followed by the persistence failure; inspect both original objects before retrying.
backendIdInvalid: `BACKEND_ID_INVALID`: the backend id breaks the id rule.
backendDuplicate: `BACKEND_DUPLICATE`: the id is already installed.
backendNotInstalled: `BACKEND_NOT_INSTALLED`: no backend with this id; there is no default.
backendPluginInvalid: `BACKEND_PLUGIN_INVALID`: the plugin or its store breaks the contract.
backendInstallFailed: `BACKEND_INSTALL_FAILED`: installation failed and was rolled back; see `cause`.
storageHostBusy: `STORAGE_HOST_BUSY`: another installation is running; retry after it settles.
storageHostDisposed: `STORAGE_HOST_DISPOSED`: the host was disposed; create a new one.
storageHostDisposeFailed: `STORAGE_HOST_DISPOSE_FAILED`: cleanup failed; the host is still terminal.
liveQueryDisposeFailed: `LIVE_QUERY_DISPOSE_FAILED`: query cleanup failed; see `errors`.
reactiveFeatureInvalid: `REACTIVE_FEATURE_INVALID`: the reactive Feature does not match the backend.
reactiveTopologyInvalid: `REACTIVE_TOPOLOGY_INVALID`: the Feature graph is unknown, duplicated or cyclic.
reactiveServiceNotInstalled: `REACTIVE_SERVICE_NOT_INSTALLED`: install a reactive plugin before creating queries.
reactiveAdapterNotInstalled: `REACTIVE_ADAPTER_NOT_INSTALLED`: the backend id is not reactive.
reactiveAdapterFailed: `REACTIVE_ADAPTER_FAILED`: the adapter failed; later changes may recover.
reactiveAdapterDisposeFailed: `REACTIVE_ADAPTER_DISPOSE_FAILED`: adapter cleanup failed.
backendDisposeFailed: `BACKEND_DISPOSE_FAILED`: backend cleanup failed.

members.name: unavailable
members.description: A storage backend is unavailable because a private-mode probe fails or localStorage, IndexedDB, * or `document` is disabled or missing. * * The caller selects `memoryStorageHost` explicitly or asks the user to enable storage access, * rather than retrying the same unavailable backend. Enforces the availability probe contract.

members.name: quotaExceeded
members.description: A write reaches the browser quota, such as `QuotaExceededError` or Firefox's * `NS_ERROR_DOM_QUOTA_REACHED`. * * The caller removes unneeded data or selects IndexedDB. The failure persists until storage * conditions change.

members.name: valueTooLarge
members.description: A serialized cookie assignment exceeds the 4 KB limit. * * The caller shortens the value, name, or attributes, or stores the data in IndexedDB. The * library does not silently truncate the assignment.

members.name: serializeFailed
members.description: Serialization fails because `JSON.stringify` throws, codec `encode` returns unexpected output, * or a memory write fails during `structuredClone`. * * The caller checks whether the value can be serialized. This is a data shape failure rather than * a backend failure.

members.name: deserializeFailed
members.description: Deserialization fails because `JSON.parse` throws, an envelope is malformed, or codec `decode` * returns unexpected output. * * The caller checks whether an external writer or newer version changes the stored data. * `onInvalid` handles the `decode` stage.

members.name: validationFailed
members.description: Schema validation fails because `ISchemaAdapter.validate` throws. The Standard Schema adapter * converts returned issues into a validation failure. * * The caller corrects the data to match the schema. `onInvalid` handles the `validate` stage.

members.name: migrationFailed
members.description: A migration function fails. * * Failure to migrate one record does not affect other records. The caller isolates the failure at * the `migrate` stage or repairs the migration logic.

members.name: transactionFailed
members.description: A transaction or exclusive entity commit fails, including IndexedDB creation/commit, host * coordination, or a callback error outside the storage error family. * * The caller checks whether the transaction crosses the automatic commit boundary or its scope * escapes. Transient concurrency failures can be retried.

members.name: duplicateKey
members.description: A logical key conflicts across the value, bytes, and record channels without `conflictPolicy: * 'replace'`. * * The caller changes the key or explicitly selects `replace` to atomically remove the same key * from other channels.

members.name: versionUnsupported
members.description: Entity envelope `__v` or the IndexedDB schema version exceeds the version known to the current * code. * * The caller upgrades the code or downgrades the data. Older code must not misread or overwrite * data from a newer version.

members.name: extensionFailed
members.description: An extension such as schema, codec, `namespaceCodec`, comparator, or diagnostic throws an * unclassified exception. * * The caller checks the extension implementation. `extensionStage` identifies the failed * extension, and `cause` retains the original exception.

members.name: transactionConflict
members.description: A read revision, global epoch, or KV entity snapshot changes before its atomic/exclusive * commit, causing a concurrent write conflict. * * The caller reads again and retries the entire transaction. This is a retryable concurrency * conflict rather than data corruption.

members.name: writeFailed
members.description: A cookie is not visible after a write because the browser silently rejects it. * * The caller checks cookie attributes (`path`, `domain`, `SameSite`, and `secure`) and capacity. * Privacy policies may still remove the cookie asynchronously.

members.name: cookieScopeAmbiguous
members.description: Multiple visible cookie scopes share a name, so the target value's scope is ambiguous. * * The caller gives each scope a unique cookie name or fixes the scope at construction to avoid * ambiguity.

members.name: invalidConfig
members.description: Web adapter input or configuration validation fails. Covers cookie `SameSite`, `Secure`, * `Partitioned`, and scope settings; IndexedDB factory, store names, and `IDBKeyRange`; * migration, schema, entity, and namespace codecs; backend options; and `selectCodec`'s * `onDiagnostic`. * * Contract shape validation uses `storage-contract`'s `INVALID_ARGUMENT`. This code covers * adapter configuration only, as a local exception to unified argument validation. * * The caller corrects the configuration before retrying. The argument or configuration failure * persists until it changes.

members.name: indexOrphan
members.description: IndexedDB sidecar contains an index row whose authoritative record is absent. Callers should * repair or rebuild the index rather than treating the skipped row as a successful query result.

members.name: indexUniqueConflict
members.description: An indexed mutation would assign one logical unique key to two authoritative records. * Uniqueness is enforced inside the record/sidecar transaction; callers must choose a different * indexed value or remove the competing record before retrying.

members.name: indexQueryInvalidated
members.description: A native `iterateRecordIndex` page observed the global or scope mutation epoch change between * pages. Each page validates a short readonly transaction, then closes it before yielding; * callers must restart the query rather than trust a mixed snapshot.

members.name: liveQueryDisposed
members.description: A live-query consumer attempted to refresh after terminal disposal. Disposal cannot revive * subscriptions or owned reactive state; callers must create a new live query instead of reusing * the disposed handle.

members.name: indexBackfillStale
members.description: A backfill operation presented an expired owner, stale generation, or conflicting checkpoint. * The batch must be rejected and rolled back; callers should retry through a fresh repository * operation after the current handle is reacquired.

members.name: indexBackfillFailed
members.description: Secondary-index backfill failed and persisting its failed readiness also failed. The caller * inspects the native aggregate's original cause/errors before retrying; neither the primary * failure nor the persistence failure may be discarded.

members.name: backendIdInvalid
members.description: A backend definition contains an invalid identifier. Callers must correct the bounded backend * ID before retrying installation.

members.name: backendDuplicate
members.description: A backend ID is already present in the host install batch or registry. Callers must use a * distinct ID or wait for the existing batch before retrying.

members.name: backendNotInstalled
members.description: A lookup requested a valid backend ID that has not been installed. Callers must install that * exact backend or select an installed ID.

members.name: backendPluginInvalid
members.description: A backend plugin or store failed its runtime contract check. Callers must repair the plugin * definition rather than relying on an unvalidated store.

members.name: backendInstallFailed
members.description: Backend creation, preparation, or PluginHost installation failed. Callers may retry after * fixing the cause, while the failed batch remains unpublished.

members.name: storageHostBusy
members.description: A host mutation was requested while another install batch is active. Callers must wait for that * batch to settle and explicitly retry.

members.name: storageHostDisposed
members.description: A host or its public operation was used after sealing or terminal disposal. Callers must create * a new host instead of reviving this one.

members.name: storageHostDisposeFailed
members.description: Host cleanup collected one or more failures. Callers must treat the host as terminal while * inspecting the aggregate errors for cleanup diagnostics.

members.name: liveQueryDisposeFailed
members.description: Live-query request or owned reactive cleanup collected one or more failures. Callers must treat * the query as terminal and inspect AggregateError.errors.

members.name: reactiveFeatureInvalid
members.description: A reactive feature descriptor, brand, provider seam, or adapter result is invalid. Callers must * correct the exact feature/backend pairing before retrying.

members.name: reactiveTopologyInvalid
members.description: Reactive feature topology contains an unknown, duplicate, malformed, or cyclic node. Callers * must repair the feature set before any host mutation occurs.

members.name: reactiveServiceNotInstalled
members.description: Host live-query service is not installed. Callers must install the admitted reactive service * before requesting a query.

members.name: reactiveAdapterNotInstalled
members.description: The requested backend lacks its reactive adapter or is not installed. Callers must use an * installed adapter-bound backend ID, with no default fallback.

members.name: reactiveAdapterFailed
members.description: A reactive adapter event, poll, or authoritative read failed. Callers should observe the query * error state and allow a later invalidation or poll to recover.

members.name: reactiveAdapterDisposeFailed
members.description: Reactive adapter, poller, query, or service cleanup collected failures. Callers must treat the * adapter as terminal and inspect AggregateError.errors.

members.name: backendDisposeFailed
members.description: Direct backend quiescence, transport, connection, or channel cleanup collected failures. * Callers must treat the backend as terminal and inspect all errors.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Table of this package’s 37 stable error codes; values are the strings on error.code. `INDEX_BACKFILL_FAILED` identifies backfill and failed-readiness persistence failing together on a native AggregateError.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import StorageErrorCode from @migaia/storage-web, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use StorageErrorCode when its const contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when StorageErrorCode does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained const example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
unavailable: `BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE`: storage is disabled or missing (private mode); pick `memoryStorageHost` or ask for access.
quotaExceeded: `QUOTA_EXCEEDED`: the browser quota is full; delete data or use IndexedDB.
valueTooLarge: `VALUE_TOO_LARGE`: a cookie value is over 4 KB.
serializeFailed: `SERIALIZE_FAILED`: encoding the value failed.
deserializeFailed: `DESERIALIZE_FAILED`: decoding the stored value failed.
validationFailed: `VALIDATION_FAILED`: the schema rejected the value.
migrationFailed: `MIGRATION_FAILED`: a migration function threw.
transactionFailed: `TRANSACTION_FAILED`: the IndexedDB transaction failed or the callback threw.
duplicateKey: `DUPLICATE_KEY`: the key is used by another channel; pass `conflictPolicy: "replace"` to overwrite.
versionUnsupported: `VERSION_UNSUPPORTED`: stored data is newer than this code.
extensionFailed: `EXTENSION_FAILED`: a schema, codec or comparator threw.
transactionConflict: `TRANSACTION_CONFLICT`: data changed concurrently; re-read and retry.
writeFailed: `WRITE_FAILED`: a written cookie was not visible afterwards.
cookieScopeAmbiguous: `COOKIE_SCOPE_AMBIGUOUS`: one cookie name is visible in several scopes.
invalidConfig: `INVALID_CONFIG`: an option or scope is invalid.
indexOrphan: `INDEX_ORPHAN`: an index points to a missing record; rebuild it.
indexUniqueConflict: `INDEX_UNIQUE_CONFLICT`: a unique index key belongs to another record.
indexQueryInvalidated: `INDEX_QUERY_INVALIDATED`: data changed during paging; restart the query.
liveQueryDisposed: `LIVE_QUERY_DISPOSED`: the live query was disposed; create a new one.
indexBackfillStale: `INDEX_BACKFILL_STALE`: an index backfill checkpoint expired; reconnect and retry.
indexBackfillFailed: `INDEX_BACKFILL_FAILED`: backfill and persisting failed readiness both failed. The native AggregateError keeps the primary error first in errors and as cause, followed by the persistence failure; inspect both original objects before retrying.
backendIdInvalid: `BACKEND_ID_INVALID`: the backend id breaks the id rule.
backendDuplicate: `BACKEND_DUPLICATE`: the id is already installed.
backendNotInstalled: `BACKEND_NOT_INSTALLED`: no backend with this id; there is no default.
backendPluginInvalid: `BACKEND_PLUGIN_INVALID`: the plugin or its store breaks the contract.
backendInstallFailed: `BACKEND_INSTALL_FAILED`: installation failed and was rolled back; see `cause`.
storageHostBusy: `STORAGE_HOST_BUSY`: another installation is running; retry after it settles.
storageHostDisposed: `STORAGE_HOST_DISPOSED`: the host was disposed; create a new one.
storageHostDisposeFailed: `STORAGE_HOST_DISPOSE_FAILED`: cleanup failed; the host is still terminal.
liveQueryDisposeFailed: `LIVE_QUERY_DISPOSE_FAILED`: query cleanup failed; see `errors`.
reactiveFeatureInvalid: `REACTIVE_FEATURE_INVALID`: the reactive Feature does not match the backend.
reactiveTopologyInvalid: `REACTIVE_TOPOLOGY_INVALID`: the Feature graph is unknown, duplicated or cyclic.
reactiveServiceNotInstalled: `REACTIVE_SERVICE_NOT_INSTALLED`: install a reactive plugin before creating queries.
reactiveAdapterNotInstalled: `REACTIVE_ADAPTER_NOT_INSTALLED`: the backend id is not reactive.
reactiveAdapterFailed: `REACTIVE_ADAPTER_FAILED`: the adapter failed; later changes may recover.
reactiveAdapterDisposeFailed: `REACTIVE_ADAPTER_DISPOSE_FAILED`: adapter cleanup failed.
backendDisposeFailed: `BACKEND_DISPOSE_FAILED`: backend cleanup failed.

blocks.text: StorageError(code,details?,message?) 的 code 必填，details 可省略；source 固定 @migaia/storage-web，顶层 message 默认 `[storage-web] ${code}`，可用第三参数覆盖。details 可含 backend/key/existingChannel/attemptedChannel/extensionStage/operation/cause；cause 可以 undefined，存在时保留原始对象与其 message/stack，不承诺顶层 message 等于底层异常。实例浅冻结，不深冻结 cause。已有 StorageError 补充 operation/stage 元数据时，新边界保留原 message，并把完整旧错误放 cause。

STORAGE_WEB_SOURCE、StorageErrorCode、StorageErrorText 为稳定公开常量；业务分支比较 source/code，文本主要供扩展实现复用。storage-contract 的 INVALID_ARGUMENT/INVALID_KEY/UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY/STORE_DISPOSED/ABORTED 从其独立入口导入；跨 schema/codec/namespace 传播已有 storage 家族错误时保留原码与原因，不二次覆盖。

rows: 后端缺失/拒写、配额、完整 Cookie assignment 过大
编码/解码、结构化复制或 envelope 失败
事务/独占提交失败，或 revision/epoch/快照变化
持久化 schema 或 entity envelope 高于当前代码
扩展回调未归类失败，查看 extensionStage/cause
Cookie 回读不可见或同名 scope 歧义
投影无原记录、唯一键占用、分页失效
回填与失败状态都失败，或 owner/代次/检查点失效
ID 非法、重复或未安装
plugin/store 契约非法，或 batch 安装失败
Host 正忙、终态或清理失败
reactive 定义或依赖图非法
缺服务或所选 backend adapter
查询/失效失败或终态清理失败

blocks.text: 遇到不可用后端，显式提示或选择 memory；Cookie 写失败检查 scope/策略；冲突先区分跨通道重复、unique 占用与乐观竞争；未知版本升级代码，不删图跳迁移；structured 数据落 text-only 时显式换 codec 或后端；live query 跨页刷新按 consistency 判断，不把提示当全量复制。Host/Query/backend 关闭后新建，不尝试复活。

symbols.core:
entityUniqueSnapshotChanged: The KV raw-text snapshot changed during preparation; `TRANSACTION_CONFLICT` asks the caller to retry the complete write.
entityMigrationGraphIncomplete: Entity construction omitted an upgrade step from 2 through the current version; correct the graph before retrying.
standardSchemaIssuesInvalid: A Standard Schema implementation returned malformed issue entries rather than message-bearing objects.
namespaceCodecEncodeInvalid: A namespace encoder returned a non-string physical key.
namespaceCodecDecodeInvalid: A namespace decoder returned neither a string key nor undefined for another namespace.
webStorageInjectionInvalid: Injected Web Storage lacks part of the required storage interface.
webStorageLengthInvalid: The live Web Storage length is not a nonnegative safe integer.
webStorageKeyInvalid: Live Web Storage enumeration did not provide a string key for a visible index.
webStorageKeyDuplicate: Live Web Storage enumeration returned the same physical key more than once.
indexedDbChangeHintKeyInvalid: An IndexedDB coordination hint contains an undecodable storage key.
indexedDbUpgradeTransactionMissing: An IndexedDB upgrade event omitted the platform-owned upgrade transaction.
cookieDocumentBecameInvalid: An admitted cookie document stopped exposing its cookie property as a string.
entityComparatorInvalid: An entity ordering callback returned an invalid comparison number.
storageKeyDecodeLimitExceeded: An encoded key exceeded the supported decode depth or node limits.
storageKeyWireInvalid: An encoded key is not the required two-slot wire tuple.
storageKeyBinaryTooLarge: A binary storage key exceeds the public encoded-key size bound.
storageKeyWireTagInvalid: An encoded storage key uses an unknown wire type tag.
backendIdInvalid: A backend identifier violates the registration name grammar before mutation.
backendDuplicate: A backend identifier is already installed or duplicated in the install batch.
backendNotInstalled: A valid backend identifier has no installed registry entry.
backendPluginInvalid: A backend plugin or returned store violates its public contract.
backendInstallFailed: Backend factory creation, preparation or PluginHost installation failed.
storageHostBusy: A host mutation was requested while another install batch was running.
storageHostDisposed: A host operation ran after the host sealed or reached terminal disposal.
storageHostDisposeFailed: Several host cleanup failures are summarized while disposal remains terminal.
liveQueryDisposeFailed: Several live-query cleanup failures are summarized after disposal.
reactiveFeatureInvalid: A reactive provider, feature or adapter descriptor has an invalid shape.
reactiveTopologyInvalid: Reactive feature topology has an unknown dependency, duplicate or cycle.
reactiveServiceNotInstalled: A live-query service was requested before installing its reactive plugin.
reactiveAdapterNotInstalled: The requested backend has no installed reactive adapter.
reactiveAdapterFailed: An adapter event, polling operation or authoritative read failed recoverably.
reactiveAdapterDisposeFailed: Reactive adapter or service cleanup produced aggregated failures.
liveQueryFailed: A live-query extension callback failed and its original cause is retained.
backendDisposeFailed: Direct backend cleanup failed and is reported through the storage boundary.
indexOrphan: An index sidecar row has no authoritative entity record.
indexQueryInvalidated: Concurrent mutation invalidated a native paged index query.
liveQueryDisposed: A permanently disposed live query was used again and must be recreated.
indexBackfillStale: The index backfill handle is stale and the query must retry.
indexBackfillProjectionTooLarge: Backfill projection work exceeded its fixed bound before sidecar writes.
indexBackfillDecodedTooLarge: Decoded backfill payload exceeded its fixed bound before issuing a partial batch.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Stable message texts used by this package, for custom backends and codecs that want the same wording; branch on `code`, not on text.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import StorageErrorText from @migaia/storage-web, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use StorageErrorText when its const contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when StorageErrorText does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained const example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
entityUniqueSnapshotChanged: The KV raw-text snapshot changed during preparation; `TRANSACTION_CONFLICT` asks the caller to retry the complete write.
entityMigrationGraphIncomplete: Entity construction omitted an upgrade step from 2 through the current version; correct the graph before retrying.
standardSchemaIssuesInvalid: A Standard Schema implementation returned malformed issue entries rather than message-bearing objects.
namespaceCodecEncodeInvalid: A namespace encoder returned a non-string physical key.
namespaceCodecDecodeInvalid: A namespace decoder returned neither a string key nor undefined for another namespace.
webStorageInjectionInvalid: Injected Web Storage lacks part of the required storage interface.
webStorageLengthInvalid: The live Web Storage length is not a nonnegative safe integer.
webStorageKeyInvalid: Live Web Storage enumeration did not provide a string key for a visible index.
webStorageKeyDuplicate: Live Web Storage enumeration returned the same physical key more than once.
indexedDbChangeHintKeyInvalid: An IndexedDB coordination hint contains an undecodable storage key.
indexedDbUpgradeTransactionMissing: An IndexedDB upgrade event omitted the platform-owned upgrade transaction.
cookieDocumentBecameInvalid: An admitted cookie document stopped exposing its cookie property as a string.
entityComparatorInvalid: An entity ordering callback returned an invalid comparison number.
storageKeyDecodeLimitExceeded: An encoded key exceeded the supported decode depth or node limits.
storageKeyWireInvalid: An encoded key is not the required two-slot wire tuple.
storageKeyBinaryTooLarge: A binary storage key exceeds the public encoded-key size bound.
storageKeyWireTagInvalid: An encoded storage key uses an unknown wire type tag.
backendIdInvalid: A backend identifier violates the registration name grammar before mutation.
backendDuplicate: A backend identifier is already installed or duplicated in the install batch.
backendNotInstalled: A valid backend identifier has no installed registry entry.
backendPluginInvalid: A backend plugin or returned store violates its public contract.
backendInstallFailed: Backend factory creation, preparation or PluginHost installation failed.
storageHostBusy: A host mutation was requested while another install batch was running.
storageHostDisposed: A host operation ran after the host sealed or reached terminal disposal.
storageHostDisposeFailed: Several host cleanup failures are summarized while disposal remains terminal.
liveQueryDisposeFailed: Several live-query cleanup failures are summarized after disposal.
reactiveFeatureInvalid: A reactive provider, feature or adapter descriptor has an invalid shape.
reactiveTopologyInvalid: Reactive feature topology has an unknown dependency, duplicate or cycle.
reactiveServiceNotInstalled: A live-query service was requested before installing its reactive plugin.
reactiveAdapterNotInstalled: The requested backend has no installed reactive adapter.
reactiveAdapterFailed: An adapter event, polling operation or authoritative read failed recoverably.
reactiveAdapterDisposeFailed: Reactive adapter or service cleanup produced aggregated failures.
liveQueryFailed: A live-query extension callback failed and its original cause is retained.
backendDisposeFailed: Direct backend cleanup failed and is reported through the storage boundary.
indexOrphan: An index sidecar row has no authoritative entity record.
indexQueryInvalidated: Concurrent mutation invalidated a native paged index query.
liveQueryDisposed: A permanently disposed live query was used again and must be recreated.
indexBackfillStale: The index backfill handle is stale and the query must retry.
indexBackfillProjectionTooLarge: Backfill projection work exceeded its fixed bound before sidecar writes.
indexBackfillDecodedTooLarge: Decoded backfill payload exceeded its fixed bound before issuing a partial batch.

blocks.text: StorageError(code,details?,message?) 的 code 必填，details 可省略；source 固定 @migaia/storage-web，顶层 message 默认 `[storage-web] ${code}`，可用第三参数覆盖。details 可含 backend/key/existingChannel/attemptedChannel/extensionStage/operation/cause；cause 可以 undefined，存在时保留原始对象与其 message/stack，不承诺顶层 message 等于底层异常。实例浅冻结，不深冻结 cause。已有 StorageError 补充 operation/stage 元数据时，新边界保留原 message，并把完整旧错误放 cause。

STORAGE_WEB_SOURCE、StorageErrorCode、StorageErrorText 为稳定公开常量；业务分支比较 source/code，文本主要供扩展实现复用。storage-contract 的 INVALID_ARGUMENT/INVALID_KEY/UNSUPPORTED_CAPABILITY/STORE_DISPOSED/ABORTED 从其独立入口导入；跨 schema/codec/namespace 传播已有 storage 家族错误时保留原码与原因，不二次覆盖。

rows: 后端缺失/拒写、配额、完整 Cookie assignment 过大
编码/解码、结构化复制或 envelope 失败
事务/独占提交失败，或 revision/epoch/快照变化
持久化 schema 或 entity envelope 高于当前代码
扩展回调未归类失败，查看 extensionStage/cause
Cookie 回读不可见或同名 scope 歧义
投影无原记录、唯一键占用、分页失效
回填与失败状态都失败，或 owner/代次/检查点失效
ID 非法、重复或未安装
plugin/store 契约非法，或 batch 安装失败
Host 正忙、终态或清理失败
reactive 定义或依赖图非法
缺服务或所选 backend adapter
查询/失效失败或终态清理失败

blocks.text: 遇到不可用后端，显式提示或选择 memory；Cookie 写失败检查 scope/策略；冲突先区分跨通道重复、unique 占用与乐观竞争；未知版本升级代码，不删图跳迁移；structured 数据落 text-only 时显式换 codec 或后端；live query 跨页刷新按 consistency 判断，不把提示当全量复制。Host/Query/backend 关闭后新建，不尝试复活。

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Typed access to one entity on one store. Fallback unique validation adds full-scan schema and projection reads without a persistent sidecar or a native capability claim. Record put, batch and migration validate the final draft and update the internal two-slot key `[REPOSITORY_KEY_PREFIX, entityName]` (`REPOSITORY_KEY_PREFIX` is `"__storage_web_entity_v2__"`) to detect concurrent new owners; raw record enumeration can see this marker, while entity queries and migration exclude it. KV preparation runs schema and codec callbacks outside the lock, then verifies the raw-text snapshot under an exclusive commit lock; changes during preparation yield retryable `TRANSACTION_CONFLICT`. Host Web Locks guarantee cross-page uniqueness and are provided by modern browsers. Injected ports without a host lock serialize within one module instance. Server-rewritten cookies follow the server and are outside this uniqueness constraint.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
extensions: APIs added by installed plugins (custom `definePlugin` installs).
use: Installs more plugins after creation; the whole batch is published atomically or rolled back. A second `use()` during installation throws `STORAGE_HOST_BUSY`.
use.plugins: Plugin handles with new, unique ids.
The same host, typed with the new backends.
backend: Returns the store installed under an id.
backend.id: Id given to the plugin (`memoryBackendPlugin({ id })`).
The store; unknown ids throw `BACKEND_NOT_INSTALLED`.
hasBackend: Tells whether an id is installed (also narrows its type).
hasBackend.id: Backend id to check.
`true` when installed.
backends: Returns a copied map of all installed stores by id; its ReadonlyMap type prevents typed mutation, but the map is not frozen at runtime.
A fresh `ReadonlyMap<string, IKeyValueStore>`; mutating the copy never changes host registrations.
hasReactiveBackend: Tells whether an id has a reactive adapter.
hasReactiveBackend.id: Backend id to check.
`true` when reactive.
reactiveBackend: Returns the reactive handle of an id: `{ id, store, liveQuery }`.
reactiveBackend.id: Id of a backend installed with a `*Reactive` plugin.
An `IReactiveBackendHandle`, or `undefined` when the id has no installed reactive adapter.
dispose: Stops admission, cancels an installation in progress, waits for running work, then releases adapters and stores. Repeated dispose calls share one Promise; other Host operations reject with `STORAGE_HOST_DISPOSED` after closing begins.
Resolves when released; cleanup errors are aggregated.

A new empty StorageHostFacade with snapped scheduler and installation budget; no backend is installed by construction. Install backend plugins through use() and await dispose() at the end of its lifetime.
extensions: APIs added by installed plugins (custom `definePlugin` installs).
use: Installs more plugins after creation; the whole batch is published atomically or rolled back. A second `use()` during installation throws `STORAGE_HOST_BUSY`.
use.plugins: Plugin handles with new, unique ids.
The same host, typed with the new backends.
backend: Returns the store installed under an id.
backend.id: Id given to the plugin (`memoryBackendPlugin({ id })`).
The store; unknown ids throw `BACKEND_NOT_INSTALLED`.
hasBackend: Tells whether an id is installed (also narrows its type).
hasBackend.id: Backend id to check.
`true` when installed.
backends: Returns a copied map of all installed stores by id; its ReadonlyMap type prevents typed mutation, but the map is not frozen at runtime.
A fresh `ReadonlyMap<string, IKeyValueStore>`; mutating the copy never changes host registrations.
hasReactiveBackend: Tells whether an id has a reactive adapter.

`true` when reactive.
reactiveBackend: Returns the reactive handle of an id: `{ id, store, liveQuery }`.

An `IReactiveBackendHandle`, or `undefined` when the id has no installed reactive adapter.
dispose: Stops admission, cancels an installation in progress, waits for running work, then releases adapters and stores. Repeated dispose calls share one Promise; other Host operations reject with `STORAGE_HOST_DISPOSED` after closing begins.
Resolves when released; cleanup errors are aggregated.
liveQuery: Only with reactive backends: creates a live query; see `ILiveQueryOptions`.
liveQuery.options: `{ backendId, runtime, query, ... }`.
An `ILiveQuery`.
installTimeoutMs: Deadline of one installation batch.
`30000`.

`systemScheduler`.

Not set.

sections.title: 介绍
sections.content: Creates an IndexedDB store with values, bytes, records, transactions, iteration and secondary indexes. The connection opens once and yields to version upgrades from other tabs. `ensureRecordIndexes` races shared opening against the operation deadline through `raceWithAbort`; stopping one waiter leaves shared preparation owned by the backend. `iterateRecordIndex` uses one deadline across the whole iterator, including buffered yields, and releases its abort subscription and timer in finally when iteration completes or the consumer calls return.

sections.title: 上手
sections.content: Import localStorageBackendPlugin from @migaia/storage-web/plugins/local-storage, then follow a maintained task example for your use case.

sections.title: 适用场景
sections.content: Use localStorageBackendPlugin when its const contract and declared inputs match the result you need. Choose a different public symbol when localStorageBackendPlugin does not match the required inputs or return contract.

sections.title: 快速实现
sections.content: Use a maintained const example that demonstrates real inputs and observable behavior.

sections.title: 核心用法
sections.content:
A plugin handle for `createStorageHost({ plugins })` or `host.use()`.
id: Caller-selected backend registration id; use this exact value with `host.backend()` and live-query `backendId`.
Omitted: register under `local`.
After installation `host.backend("local")` returns the store with exact types, and `host.hasBackend("local")` is true.

sections.title: 高阶用法
sections.content:
Disposing the host disposes the store and, for reactive plugins, its adapter.
Select one storage backend by id in application code.
